name: Sakurai Makoto
source:
She is active with an honest personality in her daily life, who never waivers from what she believes (even if she's later proven wrong.) A lively girl with long hair held in a ponytail so that she can move easily, she is well liked by her classmates, and because she is over 170cm tall, many see her as an older sister. She seems to enjoy this view of her and expresses no problems with it. Perhaps the reason she enrolled in this academy was to shake off her troubled past at a public school.

[Translated from in-game description]
